title: Q3 deck for the CFO on margins
persona: Devika, FP&A lead at Nykaa BeautyVerse
scenario: Q3 beauty-vertical margins compressed 380 bps YoY because of higher discounting in Tier-1 metros and a richer mix of own-brand beauty (which has higher fulfilment cost). Your CFO presents to the board on Monday. He wants 5 slides, not 25, that explain the compression honestly and frame the FY24 plan to recover 200 bps. He's previously rejected decks for being ‘too narrative, not enough numbers’.
badPrompt: make a Q3 deck for the cfo about margin compression
badOutput:
Q3 Margin Review

Slide 1: Overview
Slide 2: Revenue
Slide 3: Margin pressure
Slide 4: Initiatives
Slide 5: Next steps

Key points: margins compressed due to discounts and mix. We will optimize and recover.

hints.title: Anchor the CFO's allergy
hints.body: ‘He rejects decks that are too narrative, not enough numbers.’ Tone is content, every slide must lead with a number.

hints.title: Lock the slide count + slot per slide
hints.body: ‘5 slides. Each slide: one chart, one number, one sentence.’ Without this Claude pads.

checks.tip: Frame the artifact, a 5-slide board deck.
Anchor the topic, margin compression, in CFO language.
Use the actual numbers, 380 bps compression, recover 200 bps.
Anchor the two drivers, tier-1 discounting + own-brand mix shift.
Force ‘number per slide’, the CFO's allergy is decorative narrative.
Reference the CFO, board, Monday deadline. Calibrates voice.
Force honest framing, no spin. Boards pattern-match on dishonest decks fast.
Demand slide titles + 1 talking note per slide, not just bullets.
Specify the per-slide structure, headline + chart + 1 number + 1 sentence.

tipIfLow: CFO decks die from narrative bloat. The unlock is one chart + one number + one sentence per slide, locked to 5 slides, with honest framing. ‘He rejects narrative-heavy decks’ is the most useful sentence in your prompt.
goldPrompt: Act as an FP&A copywriter. I'm Devika at Nykaa BeautyVerse. CFO presents to the board Monday, allergic to narrative-heavy decks. Q3 beauty margins compressed 380 bps YoY due to higher Tier-1 discounting and own-brand mix. Output exactly 5 slides. Each slide: (1) one chart description, (2) the single number that owns the slide, (3) one sentence — 12 words max. Cover: the compression cause, mix shift, discount intensity, FY24 plan to recover 200 bps, ONE risk to the plan. Refuse to add narrative paragraphs. Refuse to add a slide 6.
